notes.detail: The earlier independent acceptance pins the pre-clarification derived performance review. The archived review adds only counter_semantics and whole_prefix_shared_request_totals. Removing precisely those two fields reproduces the earlier 3,954 bytes and captured SHA256 exactly; all raw execution evidence is unchanged. This audit binds the clarified archived version. The reconstructed prior derived report is preserved externally and is not a reconstruction of missing raw execution evidence.

method: Independent standard-library in-memory ZIP inspection, raw artifact/JSON/log comparisons and read-only Git-object verification in the coordinator-granted exclusive archive window. No product imports, runtime, tests, archive extraction, archive creation or Git mutation.
limitations: This is an archive integrity and scoped development-evidence audit; it is not full release input-closure or resulting-main verification.
Full original recording gate remains 23/28; capped failures establish neither complete request cost nor complete request savings.
Native/browser/visual, full regression and unexecuted compatibility roles remain pending.
The neutral profiler disables the optimized path and is only claimed for the checkpoint025 control.
Tracked historical archive receipts were compared against the recorded closure; historical unavailable raw logs were not reconstructed.
GitHub branch and PR metadata in the summary is coordinator-observed context; no network status refresh was performed by this archive audit.
